nodes.summary: The Fredholm index of a direct sum is the sum of the Fredholm indices.
nodes.title: Fredholm index of a direct sum is additive

nodes.summary: A direct sum is compact iff both summands are compact.
nodes.title: Compactness of a direct sum operator

nodes.summary: A direct sum is Fredholm iff both summands are Fredholm.
nodes.title: Fredholmness of a direct sum operator

nodes.summary: A direct sum is a unit iff both summands are units.
nodes.title: Invertibility of a direct sum operator

nodes.summary: The kernel of a direct sum is the product of the kernels.
nodes.title: Kernel of a direct sum operator

nodes.summary: The operator norm of a direct sum is the maximum of the operator norms.
nodes.title: Operator norm of a direct sum is the maximum of the norms
Composition of direct sum operators is componentwise

nodes.summary: The identity direct sum is the identity.
nodes.title: Direct sum of identity operators is the identity

nodes.summary: Scaling a direct sum scales both summands by the same factor.
nodes.title: Scalar multiplication of a direct sum operator

nodes.summary: The zero direct sum is zero.
nodes.title: Direct sum of zero operators is zero

nodes.summary: The range of a direct sum is the product of the ranges.
nodes.title: Range of a direct sum operator

nodes.summary: The resolvent set of a direct sum is the intersection of the resolvent sets.
nodes.title: Resolvent set of a direct sum operator

nodes.summary: The spectrum of a direct sum is the union of the spectra.
nodes.title: Spectrum of a direct sum operator is the union of spectra

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
